model_metadata.name: Remote shell

model_metadata.shape: Long flat barrel with a remote-shaped bar, forward trigger grip, open rear handle dropping down and back
model_metadata.notes: Split hold by default; grip_two is the rear docking hold. Two-player mode draws two shells with no accessory. Original authored proportions; no traced or imported content.

accessory_metadata.name: Analog stick grip
accessory_metadata.resembles: A small one-hand grip with top analog stick and two front buttons
accessory_metadata.shape: Rounded tapered grip, analog stick on top, C and Z on the front; no cable or muzzle
accessory_metadata.notes: Grip anchor at the web of the off hand; controller follows its grip pose. No bore, muzzle or gun effects. Stored alongside gun assembly assets but never selected as a firing gun.

model_metadata.name: Remote shell
model_metadata.resembles: A white remote-in-barrel shell, held at its forward trigger grip
model_metadata.shape: Long flat barrel with a remote-shaped bar, forward trigger grip, open rear handle dropping down and back
model_metadata.notes: Split hold by default; grip_two is the rear docking hold. Two-player mode draws two shells with no accessory. Original authored proportions; no traced or imported content.

accessory_metadata.name: Analog stick grip
accessory_metadata.resembles: A small one-hand grip with top analog stick and two front buttons
accessory_metadata.shape: Rounded tapered grip, analog stick on top, C and Z on the front; no cable or muzzle
accessory_metadata.notes: Grip anchor at the web of the off hand; controller follows its grip pose. No bore, muzzle or gun effects. Stored alongside gun assembly assets but never selected as a firing gun.

model_metadata.name: Remote shell
model_metadata.resembles: A white remote-in-barrel shell, held at its forward trigger grip
model_metadata.shape: Long flat barrel with a remote-shaped bar, forward trigger grip, open rear handle dropping down and back
model_metadata.notes: Split hold by default; grip_two is the rear docking hold. Two-player mode draws two shells with no accessory. Original authored proportions; no traced or imported content.

accessory_metadata.name: Analog stick grip
accessory_metadata.resembles: A small one-hand grip with top analog stick and two front buttons
accessory_metadata.shape: Rounded tapered grip, analog stick on top, C and Z on the front; no cable or muzzle
accessory_metadata.notes: Grip anchor at the web of the off hand; controller follows its grip pose. No bore, muzzle or gun effects. Stored alongside gun assembly assets but never selected as a firing gun.
